Question 5

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫Cxydx+xdy, where C is parametrized by r(t)=eti+et+1j for t∈[0,1]?

a
2∫01e2t+1dt
b
∫01e3t+1+e2t+1dt
c
2∫01e3t+1dt
d
∫01e5t+2dt
e
∫01e3t+e2tdt
